name: Rocky Mountain spring-beauty
desc: Rocky Mountain spring-beauty (Claytonia rosea): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 82 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Claytonia rosea, commonly called Rocky Mountain spring beauty, western springbeauty or Madrean springbeauty, is a diminutive spring blooming ephemeral plant with pale pink to magenta flowers.
